reforms.description: The 'Temporary Measures Law for Structural Improvement of Specific Industries' was enacted to assist in the elimination of excess capacity and promote the development and application of new technology in 26 industries.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The reform aims to enhance technological development and application, which supports economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The law has been enacted and is currently in force.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform represents a significant structural change aimed at improving industry capacity and technology.
reforms.source_quote: New legislation (the 'Temporary Measures Law for Structural Improvement of Specific Industries') was therefore put in place.

reforms.description: The System of Subsidies for Promoting the Development of Computers was adopted, providing conditional loans for the development costs of new machines to boost the domestic computer industry.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The subsidies are designed to stimulate investment in the computer industry, fostering innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The system has been adopted and is currently operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the reform is not as transformative as major structural changes.
reforms.source_quote: In 1971, the System of Subsidies for Promoting the Development of Computers was adopted: a 50 percent conditional loan was provided for the development costs of the new machines.
